title: AM scheduling hotlist — Tilly Morgan
content:
Date: 2026-03-26
Quick brain dump / running to-do (hotlist) — for day shift and any handoff to evening cover. Mostly shorthand.

TOP PRIORITIES (today)
- Ensure final confirm for 4pm interview with Maya Z (SWE) — candidate needed Zoom link + short prep doc.
- Reschedule no-show from yesterday (Elias B) and follow up on reason + reschedule window.
- Clear out all calendar conflicts for Friday’s onsite panel + confirm panelist availability by EOD.
- Finish offer packet draft for IC hiring manager review (submit to legal loop).

CANDIDATE FOLLOW-UPS (action + quick script)
1) Maya Z (SWE) — 4pm PT
   - TZ: PT (San Francisco)
   - Action: Send Zoom link + 2-bullet prep + interviewer list
   - Script (send now): "Hi Maya — confirming your interview today at 4:00 PM PT with Redwood. Join: [zoom link]. Interviewers: Priya K (Hiring Mgr), Omar R. Quick prep: (1) Expect 45m system design + take-home discussion; (2) Bring a question about latency/scale. Reply if you need to reschedule"
   - Note: Priya asked for a 5m pre-brief at 3:50 — block calendar.

2) Elias B — no-show on 03/25
   - TZ: CET (London)
   - Action: polite follow-up + offer 2 alternative windows next week
   - Script: "Hi Elias — we missed you for the interview yesterday. Is everything OK? If you still want to proceed, here are two windows: Tue 10:00 AM GMT or Wed 2:00 PM GMT. Let me know what works and I’ll lock it in."
   - Tag: check hiring manager availability before proposing.

3) Amrita S (Recruiter ref) — phone screen scheduling
   - Action: Quick availability poll (use Doodle or Calendly link)
   - Script: "Hi Amrita — can you share 3 windows in the next 5 business days? If easier, use my Calendly: [link]."

CALENDAR / OPS CHECKS
- Double-check Priya's calendar for overlapping 1:1s at 3:45 — move 3:30 1:1 to 2:45 if needed.
- Panel slots for Friday onsite: confirm room + Zoom fallback (Facilities ticket if >6 folks).
- Interviewer prep docs: attach latest looped candidate resume + 1-paragraph hiring rubric. Use template: /confluence/recruiting/interview-templates (link in slack).

TODAY TIMEBLOCKS (rough)
- 8:30–9:15 AM: inbox triage + quick reschedule emails (block)
- 9:15–10:00 AM: candidate phone screens (2x 20m)
- 10:30–11:00 AM: sync with Hiring Ops (Nina) — review panel list
- 11:30–12:00 PM: offer packet draft to Hiring Mgr
- 1:00–2:30 PM: admin / calendaring / refill buffer for late replies
- 3:50–4:00 PM: pre-brief with Priya for Maya
- 4:00–5:00 PM: live interview (Maya) + quick debrief
- 5:00–5:30 PM: end-of-day handoff note to evening cover (Samir)

MISC NOTES / REMINDERS
- Always include timezone in candidate messages (I keep screwing up when hiring managers assume local).
- For candidates in APAC: offer 2 slots that are morning PT-friendly (e.g., 7:30 AM PT & 9:00 AM PT) and mark 'early-morning' so hiring managers are aware.
- No-shows: polite check-in within 24h, then archive note and ask recruiter to flag if ghosting continues.

TEMPLATES (paste into Slack or Gmail drafts)
- Interview confirmation (short):
  "Subject: Confirming interview — [Role] at Redwood — [Date/Time TZ]
  Hi [Name],
  Confirming your interview on [date] at [time] [TZ]. Zoom: [link]. Interviewers: [names]. Expect ~45 minutes. Reply if any conflict. — Tilly"

- No-show follow-up (short + empathetic):
  "Hi [Name],
  We missed you for your interview earlier — hope everything is ok. If you’re still interested, I can propose a couple of new times. If not, no worries — let me know.
  Best,
  Tilly"

HANDOFF CHECKPOINT (what to tell evening person)
- Who to chase: Elias B (no-show), Amrita S (poll), Priya (final confirm pre-brief), Friday panel confirmations.
- Slack note to leave: quick bullet list + any candidate responses arriving after 5pm should be triaged to "urgent" if they request same-day reschedule.

OPEN QUESTIONS / BLOCKERS
- Legal still needs to confirm sign-off window for salary bands (impact: offer timing). Who on legal is fastest?
- Facilities: do we have a physical overflow room for >6 interviewers Friday? Ticket pending (FAC-988).

TO-DO (checklist)
- [ ] Send Maya confirmation + pre-brief
- [ ] Draft offer packet + send to Priya for review
- [ ] Email Elias for reschedule (include two GMT windows)
- [ ] Post panel availability message in #hiring-panel channel
- [ ] Update candidate tracker spreadsheet (row for Elias with no-show note)

NOTES TO SELF (short)
- Bring a printed copy of candidate rubrics for onsite Fridays — less fiddly than screen sharing.
- After 5pm: batch any non-urgent reschedules for tomorrow.

END-OF-DAY HANDOFF TEMPLATE (to paste into Slack)
"EOD handoff — Tilly: pending items for tonight: Elias B follow-up (email sent?), Amrita S availability, Priya pre-brief confirmed. Any urgent candidate replies ping me mobile x-112."

---
Tiny reminders: breathe. Keep templates short. If a hiring manager micro-manages scheduling, set expectations once: "I’ll propose windows and confirm your availability when candidate picks a slot."

Last updated quick note: 2026-03-26 17:28 — will update after debrief.
